tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards; the sidebar and top bar sit on it too.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, the sidebar panel.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inside a card: search fields, tab tracks, the empty allocation bar track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, card dividers. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control edges that must be seen: the dashed Add tile, outlined buttons, unchecked toggles. 3:1 on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, figures and body copy on canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary labels, axis ticks, metadata, section overlines on canvas, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: on-bright
tokens.usage: Text and icons on every bright fill and gradient: tangerine, coral, mint, sky, teal, berry, sun. Same deep ink in both themes.

tokens.name: tangerine
tokens.usage: The signature hue. Fills: primary buttons, active nav, selected tab, chart line. Never as text — use tangerine-ink.

tokens.name: tangerine-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground: soft buttons, the selected payment card wash, the selected tab in a quiet track.

tokens.name: tangerine-ink
tokens.usage: Orange text and icons on surface, canvas and tangerine-soft; also the focus ring.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Warm gradient stop and highlight dots. Fill only.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Destructive or outbound actions (Send, Remove) as a fill.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind coral-ink.

tokens.name: coral-ink
tokens.usage: Negative deltas and error text on surface, canvas and coral-soft.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Positive fill: success dots, gains in charts.

tokens.name: mint-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind mint-ink.

tokens.name: mint-ink
tokens.usage: Positive deltas (+14.5%) and success text on surface, canvas and mint-soft.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Second series colour: ETH in allocation, secondary chart line.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind sky-ink.

tokens.name: sky-ink
tokens.usage: Info text and links on surface, canvas and sky-soft.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Third series colour: stablecoins (USDT) in allocation and legends.

tokens.name: berry
tokens.usage: Fourth series colour: Other in allocation; the pink end of the berry gradient.

tokens.name: berry-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind berry-ink.

tokens.name: berry-ink
tokens.usage: Accent text on surface, canvas and berry-soft.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links — an alias of sky-ink.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Poppins from Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700. Headings are semibold, never bold.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per screen, top-left of the content area.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Card headings, beside an icon or a control.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: Money and quantities. Always tabular numerals (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The one headline number on a card — the total balance.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Your balance moved 3.2% since this morning.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Nav items, button labels, tab labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Sidebar section headings, in ink-muted, uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-number gaps, legend dot to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value; inside chips and tabs.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a row; nav item inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Stacked rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gutters between cards; page padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

radius.note: Generously rounded, never sharp; pills for anything that toggles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tabs, chips, the allocation bar ends.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the chart tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Payment cards and hero tiles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, toggles, token icons, legend dots.

shadow.note: Soft and warm in light; in dark, cards separate by surface, and glows carry the colour.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Tooltips, menus, the chart callout.

tokens.name: glow-tangerine
tokens.usage: Under the active nav item and primary buttons — the playful lift.

tokens.name: glow-berry
tokens.usage: Under berry-gradient tiles.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px surface gap then 2px solid tangerine-ink (3:1+ on every surface).

gradient.note: Gradients are fills, never text. Every gradient keeps on-bright legible from end to end.

tokens.name: gradient-tangerine
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active nav, selected tab, the selected payment card. The default gradient.

tokens.name: gradient-sunset
tokens.usage: Hero tiles and promo banners; one per screen.

tokens.name: gradient-berry
tokens.usage: Payment cards, achievement tiles.

tokens.name: gradient-lagoon
tokens.usage: Payment cards, info tiles. Teal to blue — stop at blue, never purple.

tokens.name: gradient-mint
tokens.usage: Success tiles, the gain area in a chart.

tokens.name: gradient-spectrum
tokens.usage: Thin decorative rules: the top edge of a hero card, a loading bar. Not for data.

tokens.name: gradient-area
tokens.usage: Fill under a chart line (the AreaChart draws its own SVG version).
